input.content: Pattern: new-feature behavior not gated behind its own feature flag (backward-compat break). In client.save_settings, a `enhanced_settings=False` parameter exists but is inert (only echoed into the return value), while the feature's actual new behavior — sending `require_receipt: True` and raising when `response["applied"] is not True` — runs unconditionally for every caller. Effect: legacy/non-enhanced callers and providers that return `{"ok": True}` without an `applied` receipt now raise RuntimeError. Review heuristic: when a diff adds a feature-named flag parameter, verify the feature's new side effects/enforcement are actually conditioned on that flag; an inert flag + unconditional new behavior signals a gating bug or a redundant parameter.
